name: Military Unit

fields.label: Series
fields.description: `MIL-UNIT-` by default, or `MIL-BRG-` when the unit is a brigade and the registrar prefers the readable prefix (both patterns are in `naming.SERIES_CATALOG`).

fields.label: Business code
fields.description: An optional external code (`military_unit.code UNIQUE`). Kept separate from the document name because a code is reusable business data while `name` is the permanent key.

fields.label: Group (has subordinates)
fields.description: Frappe's tree convention, inherited by every unit that has sub-units. Kept as a Check rather than derived, because a formation can legitimately have no subordinates yet.

fields.label: Parent unit
fields.description: Native tree. The source maintains `path`/`depth` by hand in `rules.compute_path`; NestedSet gives the same subtree semantics, plus a tree view and `treeview` reports.

fields.label: Echelon
fields.options:
Brigade
Division
Regiment
Battalion
Company
Platoon
Squadron
Detachment
fields.description: Brigade … Detachment (`vocab.UNIT_ECHELONS`); default Brigade, as in the source.

fields.label: Role
fields.description: Free text, exactly as the source has it: `role` is not in `VOCAB_FIELDS`, so no list constrains it and none is invented here.

fields.label: Commander
fields.description: Only a person of the military category can hold a command (`rules.check_commander_person`) — the link filter makes that rule visible before it is enforced.

fields.label: Current deployment
fields.description: Maintained by the controller when a deployment's state or `is_current` flag changes: at most one current deployment per unit (`rules.check_deployment`). Read-only because the deployment is the record that owns that fact.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Active
Training
Standby
Mobilized
Attached
Reserve
Reorganizing
Stand-down
Disbanded
fields.description: Nine states, from `vocab.UNIT_STATUSES`. Deliberately *set-valued only*: the source treats unit status as owner-reviewable and imposes no transition table.

fields.label: Direct personnel
fields.description: People posted directly to this unit, not its subordinates. The subtree total is a rollup the controller computes — the source's `descendant_personnel()` query, answered natively by the NestedSet.

fields.label: Subtree personnel
fields.description: Σ direct_personnel over the whole subtree. Read-only and recomputed on save: it is the one number a commander asks for, and it must never be typed.

fields.label: Armament holdings
fields.description: One row per (unit, armament) with quantity and condition — the source's `unit_armament` table, which is genuinely data a unit owns, so it is a child table here.

fields.label: Emblem
fields.description: The unit's own emblem (migration 017). Native File: private by default, permission-checked.

fields.label: Latitude
fields.description: This record's own latitude, independent of any linked place.

fields.label: Longitude
fields.description: This record's own longitude, independent of any linked place.

fields.label: Geolocation
fields.description: Select a point on the map. It is mirrored into the latitude and longitude fields and resolves the administrative hierarchy.

fields.label: Locality / place name
fields.description: Nearest named place (village/town); auto-filled by reverse-geocoding.

fields.label: 0,0 is an actual point
fields.description: Tick only when latitude 0 and longitude 0 are a deliberate real location; otherwise the zero pair is treated as unset.

fields.label: Coordinate precision
fields.description: How close the point is to the true position.

fields.label: How the point was obtained
fields.options:
manual
map_pick
coordinate_entry
gazetteer
administrative
city_centroid
geocoder
historical_map
inherited
fields.description: A city centroid is not a street address; recording the method stops a centroid from being read as a verified location.

fields.label: Uncertainty radius (m)
fields.description: The radius the true position could lie within.

fields.label: Point source
fields.description: The map, survey or gazetteer the coordinates came from.

fields.label: Geographic description
fields.description: How the unit's position sits relative to its headquarters and the terrain around it.

fields.label: Place (HQ location)
fields.description: Link to a Place record (e.g. base, garrison, command region as a Place) for this unit's position when it has no direct coordinates.

fields.label: Primary source
fields.description: The source the record rests on. Additional claims from other sources are recorded in the Evidence table, one claim per row.

fields.label: Authentication level
fields.description: How strongly the record's content is verified.

fields.label: Record status
fields.description: Editorial state, driven by the SIRAJ Review workflow (Draft → In Review → Verified → Published, plus Needs Update / Disputed / Archived / Rejected).

fields.label: Researcher's notes
fields.description: Internal working notes. At permission level 1, so visible to reviewers and administrators only; discussion belongs in the document's comment thread instead.

fields.label: Evidence
fields.description: One row per claim: which source says what, where in the source, whether it supports or contradicts, and who verified it. Not copied with the record: a claim is evidence about one specific record.

fields.label: External identifiers
fields.description: VIAF, Wikidata, ORCID, library catalogue or legacy numbers, kept out of the record's own identifier. Never copied: an authority identifier belongs to exactly one record.

description: The military unit tree — the source's `military_unit` table and the centre of the module. A NestedSet, so the chain of command is traversable rather than merely described.
